## How tested
- [ ] `ruff check . && ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `pytest`
- [ ] `pytest -m slow` (if model/search behaviour changed)
- [ ] Checked in the app (screenshot below if UI changed)

## Docs
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` (Unreleased) if user-visible
- [ ] `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` if modules/file formats changed
- [ ] `docs/DECISIONS.md` if a real alternative was chosen
- [ ] `docs/PROGRESS.md` task board + handoff entry
